title: Correct plate voltage
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 8 V, derived from energy conservation between the plates.

title: Correct output power
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 23 W, calculated from the circuit current and resistances.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem correctly, relating kinetic energy, gravitational potential, and electric potential energy for the charged ball.

title: Circuit analysis
description: Important: Correctly uses Ohm's law for the closed circuit to find the current, accounting for internal resistance and the voltage across the plates.

title: Rheostat resistance calculation
description: Important: Calculates the resistance of the sliding rheostat using Ohm's law with the plate voltage and circuit current.

title: Power formula application
description: Important: Correctly calculates the power supply's output power using P = I²R_total for the external circuit.

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the sign for the work done by the electric field (e.g., using +qU instead of -qU for a positive charge moving against the field).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all quantities (e.g., distance from cm to m) correctly and maintains SI units throughout.
